Description
AbstractBehaviorStrategy
Base class shared by the concrete behaviour strategies.
AbstractObservable

Agent

AgentState
Possible states of an agent during an evacuation.
AgentTracker
Records the movement history of every agent.
AlertPanel
Supervision alert log.
BehaviorStrategy
Strategy side of the Strategy design pattern: encapsulates how an agent decides where to go next.
CalmEvacuationStrategy
Behaviour of a calm agent.
ConcertHallBuilder
Builds the graph of a concert hall: rows of seats, a left, centre and right corridor, a stage and four emergency exits (S1..S4).
DisplayPanel
Physical display panel covering one sector of the venue.
Edge

EventPhase
Phase of the event being supervised.
FrozenStrategy
Behaviour of a frozen agent.
Graph
The graph modelling the concert hall: a set of Nodes connected by Edges.
GraphCanvas
JavaFX view that renders the concert hall and the agents on a 2D canvas.
GraphCanvas.DisplayMode
Available rendering modes.
GraphController
Controller handling live edits of the graph during the simulation.
GraphException
Thrown when an illegal operation is attempted on the graph, such as adding a duplicate node, linking an edge to an unknown node, or removing an element that does not exist.
LeaderFollowStrategy
Behaviour of an agent that follows a leader.
Main
Entry point of the SafeExit application.
Node
A node in the concert-hall graph.
NodeType
Kinds of node that can appear in a concert-hall graph.
Observable
Observable side of the Observer design pattern.
Observer
Observer side of the Observer design pattern.
PanelMessage
Instruction displayed on a physical sector panel.
PanelMessage.ArrowDirection
Direction of the arrow drawn on the panel.
PanelMode
Operating mode of a physical sector display panel.

Behaviour of a panicked agent.

RowSensor
Aggregated occupancy sensor for a whole row.
SafeExitApp
JavaFX supervision dashboard of SafeExit.
SeatSensor

Sector

SensorNetwork
The whole occupancy-sensor layer of the venue.

SimulationEngine
Drives the simulation one cycle at a time.
SimulationEvent
Immutable event emitted by the model whenever its state changes.
SimulationEvent.Type
Categories of events that can occur during a simulation.
SimulationSerializer

SimulationState
